title: Can one get good results without having played pokemen before?
author: CPMP

original_post.author: CPMP
original_post.content: Asking for a friend… Understanding the domain of a competition is very often key. Is it true here?

replies.author: ISAKA Tsuyoshi
replies.content: Absolutely! Compared to other trading card games like MTG or Yu-Gi-Oh!, the rules of the Pokémon TCG are much simpler. It's designed so that even a 10-year-old can play it. Of course, just because the rules are simple doesn't necessarily mean it'll be an easy AI task to solve, though!

replies.author: Eduardo Rocha de Andrade
replies.content: I'm in a worse position than your friend since I'm not really familiar with neither Pokemon nor RL literature 😅 As other mentioned, the rules are quite simple and the meta seems to be only a handful of decks so it's quite quick to get familiar with their mechanics. So, my gut feeling tells me that, although very useful, it's not necessary to get a good score as we can get a somewhat decent domain knowledge in a few days.

replies.author: Jack
replies.content: Play a few games yourself and you'll understand what's going on well enough to work on this

replies.author: CPMP
replies.content: Don't underestimate 10 years old. They beat Adults at many things.

replies.author: CPMP
replies.content: coding agents can mitigate the lack of RL knowledge. Not sure they can mitigate the lack of Pokemon experience. We'll see.

replies.author: Abhyuday
replies.content: I made it to rank 50 just watching https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eKC5PlYoboE&t=1s and with basic RL principles I learnt from Orbit Wars. So totally possible. Going with a rule based approach probably needs quite a bit of domain knowledge though. I am however struggling a bit to identify weaknesses at this point, so having domain knowledge or teaming up with someone who does seems important.

replies.author: MagicTrashBag
replies.content: I got up to 12th at one point and I have never played anything besides the mobile TCG. I do collect tho :)
